Golden Hour Club

Business people. Sunset. No speeches.

Once a month, the people who actually build things in Bali meet at a pool as the sun goes down. No stage, no slides, no sponsors pitching from the front. Just a cold drink and the people worth knowing.

Request your invitationJoin the WhatsApp group
One weekday evening a month · Places limited
The idea

The opposite of a networking event

Bali has plenty of talks, panels and paid memberships. We wanted the part everyone actually comes for — the conversations afterwards — and nothing else.

01

No speeches

No presentations, no panels, no one selling from a stage. A sixty-second welcome at sunset, then the evening is yours.

02

No fee

Membership is free for the whole first year.

03

The right room

Founders, owners, investors and the people who run things — from property and hospitality to tech, export and finance.

The evening

One weekday evening a month, poolside

Which night? Members choose — tell us yours when you request your invitation. Arrive for golden hour, leave when you like. Bali smart — what you'd wear to a good beach club.

  • 17:30Doors open · welcome drink by the pool
  • 18:15Sunset · a one-minute toast from your host
  • 18:30Introductions — newcomers are walked over to two people worth meeting
  • 21:00The night carries on — or doesn't. Your call.

The group chat

Three house rules. That's all.

Members share one open WhatsApp group. Ask for help, share news, show us your company or your own group. Just keep to three things.

1

Mention your thing once

Showing your business is welcome. Posting it again and again is not.

2

No personal abuse

Disagree with ideas, never with people.

3

No bigotry

Everyone in the room is welcome. Everything else is fine.
